Intended for similarity search, change detection, and downstream geospatial machine learning tasks.

readme:
## README.md
This repository contains [Clay](https://clay.earth/) foundation model embeddings created and maintained by [lgnd.ai](https://lgnd.ai/). Each embedding is a multi-dimensional vector representation of a satellite image chip (a fixed-size [Major TOM](https://huggingface.co/Major-TOM) grid cell), useful for similarity search, change detection, and downstream geospatial ML tasks. The data is broken into several top-level datasets, click into each for more details: - **scene-level (COMING SOON)** - one embedding per chip per scene acquisition, the full-resolution dataset. - **[monthly-aggregated](https://source.coop/clay/lgnd-embeddings/monthly-aggregated)** - deduplicated to one embedding per chip per month, derived from the scene-level dataset. - **[rasters](https://source.coop/clay/lgnd-embeddings/rasters)** - STAC GeoParquet catalog of the source imagery: scene footprints, acquisition times, and COG asset URLs. ## Coverage | Collection | Coverage | Temporal Range | Scenes | Embeddings | Source Imagery | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | `sentinel-2-l2a` | Global | Jan 2017 - April 2026 | ~2.8M | ~15.2B | ~2.2 PB | ## Available Configurations | Model Version | Collection | Chip Size | Embedding Dims | |---|---|---|---| | `v1.5` | `sentinel-2-l2a` | `1280m` | `256` | | `v1.5` | `sentinel-2-l2a` | `2560m` | `1024` | ## License All products are licensed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
